auditor_caution: ClimateFEVER labels are majority votes over retrieved Wikipedia sentences. Some SUPPORTS/REFUTES rows in the 40-claim slice have noisy evidence pages. Seed articles use only claims whose labels match independent NASA/NOAA/IUCN/USGS/IPCC pages listed in sources.md. Do not treat ClimateFEVER SUPPORTS as a licence to assert every viral headline as physics.
